items.title: 18.4 Predicting Formula and Charge of a Complex Ion

source_refs.note: Topic 18.4 with Table 18.3, checked against the page image (PDF 24).

blocks.text: The formula and charge of a complex ion follow from the central metal ion, its oxidation state, and the ligands with their charges. The general form is [M(L)x]y, where M is the central metal ion, L the ligand, x the number of ligands (set by the coordination number) and y the overall charge, positive, negative or zero.

blocks.caption: Predicting the formula and charge of a complex ion (book's Table 18.3)
rows: Charge = metal charge + (number of ligands x ligand charge)

blocks.title: Writing the formula
blocks.text: Write the metal first, then the ligand with its number as a subscript, all inside square brackets, and put the overall charge outside the brackets as a superscript.

blocks.prompt: Predict the formula and charge of the complex formed by Cu2+ with four Cl- ligands.

items: [M(L)x]y: charge y = metal charge + x times ligand charge.
